topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 131 project-authored contract(s) across 13 chain(s); 11 ERC20 tokens, 7 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 27 common project-authored base contract(s) (misoaccesscontrols, misoadminaccess, safetransfer). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
